editorial_corrections: Recession labels and stock-market contraction labels describe different targets.
New lab explicitly demonstrates h=0 nowcasting; never report its result as advance crash forecasting.
Use feature release dates, vintages, target horizon and label announcement availability in every split; chronological indices alone cannot repair revised macro data or unavailable labels.
Choose hyperparameters and features within chronological development validation; freeze procedure before final evaluation.
ROC-AUC, average precision, probability calibration and decision costs are different criteria. Include rare-class baseline, confusion matrix and event counts.
QPS sometimes means twice Brier; state the exact convention.
Random Forest randomizes candidate features within bagged trees; gradient boosting fits sequential loss gradients, not simply majority voting over unchanged trees.
C is inverse regularization strength in sklearn LogisticRegression.
Feature transformations do not by themselves prove stationarity; feature importance is neither causal evidence nor proof of universal usefulness.
Omit obsolete current-events claims and unsupported data-growth statistics from the source.
